name: Special Workspaces
description: Isolated special-workspace state and UI: per-button dot/pill indicators, dimmed highlight, blocked navigation while isolated, and dock auto-hide awareness of special-workspace windows. Pairs with positive.workspace-app-indicator for the focused-app badge.
author: POSiTiiiV
permissions: Reads /tmp/ambxst_special_ws.txt to track the active isolated special workspace
Blocks workspace navigation and dims the active-workspace highlight while a special workspace is open
Includes special-workspace windows when the dock decides whether to auto-hide
